description: This Java interface defines a Spring Data JPA repository for managing PredefinedShelf entities, including methods for retrieving shelves by user, shelf name, ID, and a custom query for reading shelves.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for PredefinedShelf entities, providing CRUD operations and custom queries.

methods.name: findAllByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all PredefinedShelf entities associated with a specific user, including their books.

methods.name: findByPredefinedShelfNameAndUser
methods.description: Finds a PredefinedShelf by its name and user, including its books.

methods.name: countAllByUser
methods.description: Counts the number of shelves associated with a specific user.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a PredefinedShelf by its ID, including its books.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all PredefinedShelf entities, including their books.

methods.name: findReadShelf2
methods.description: Custom query to find shelves with the name 'READ'.

calls: JpaRepository methods (save, delete, findById, findAll, etc.)
